fact: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, with the Interior Ministry, said it had built the integration platform and the biometric verification and e-signature infrastructure on the national ID, developed entirely by Egyptian hands and expertise, reflecting a commitment to developing and owning its core digital infrastructure, launched as a pilot in August 2026.
title: Egypt Launches Biometric Verification, e-Signature System for Digital Services
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT), Egypt
